title: Rubix
tagline: Rubix is a city based metaverse platform. Users can explore a city-based map in the game. The map may show offline events, tourist attractions, and online gatherings.
description:
The map can contain several IRL and Online attraction points. 

A traveler can use the mobile application to explore the best places in the city.
An event organizer can use it to host events and distribute digital collectibles. The platform also provides hassle-free NFT ticket creation and validation without an external wallet.
Streamers can play interactive games with their fans and hold giveaways.
People can watch movies in a virtual theatre with their friends.
And much more..!
how_its_made:
- The game is built with VueJS along with ThreeJS for 3D rendering.

- The game uses the Livepeer network for event streaming and broadcasting, and NFT.storage for storing the streaming video.

- NFT tickets are minted on the Polygon network along with NFT.storage for assets

- ETH Pass is used for issuing passes and validation

The rooms in the games were locked with NFT passes. A user can validate using ETH Pass and enter the room to watch the Livestream.
